instructions.title: Stay calm and alert
instructions.subtitle: Assess your immediate surroundings before taking action.
instructions.details: During any alarm or sudden emergency, maintain composure. Panic hinders rational judgment. Look for clear exit paths, identify nearest emergency exits or safety stations, and help those who require assistance.

instructions.title: Follow official announcements
instructions.subtitle: Only rely on verified university alerts and campus security.
instructions.details: Do not spread unverified rumors across social messaging apps. CampusSafe broadcasts real-time verified updates directly synchronized with the SRMIST Security Control Room and Proctorate.

instructions.title: Avoid isolated areas
instructions.subtitle: Stick to illuminated, CCTV-monitored campus walkways.
instructions.details: When commuting across campus after sunset, choose well-lit main arterial avenues (GST Service Road, University Avenue, Hostel Boulevard). Avoid unlit construction sectors or lake edges without accompaniment.

instructions.title: Report any suspicious activity
instructions.subtitle: Security is a shared responsibility among all SRMites.
instructions.details: If you notice unattended packages, erratic vehicles, or individuals loitering near residential areas without university identification badges, immediately inform Security or use the CampusSafe 1-Tap SOS.

emergencyProcedures.title: Fire & Smoke Evacuation
steps: Pull the nearest manual call point fire alarm if not already triggered.
Evacuate via marked staircases. NEVER use passenger lifts or elevators.
Stay low if smoke is present; breathe through a cloth.
Assemble at your department's designated Emergency Assembly Ground.

emergencyProcedures.title: Medical Trauma & Fainting
steps: Call SRM Hospital Ambulance immediately via CampusSafe Contacts (+91 98765 43211 DEMO).
Do not move the injured person if a spinal or neck trauma is suspected.
Ensure clear airway and loosen tight collar clothing.
Send someone to the main block entrance to guide paramedics directly to the room.

emergencyProcedures.title: Chemical / Lab Hazard
steps: Immediately flush contaminated skin/eyes at the lab Emergency Eye Wash / Drench Shower for 15 minutes.
Turn off master gas and electrical valves if safe to do so.
Evacuate the laboratory and close all doors to contain fumes.
Inform lab superintendents and campus safety marshals immediately.

safetyTips.title: Night Campus Navigation
safetyTips.summary: Use the Campus Buddy system when walking back to hostels after late lab hours.

safetyTips.title: Locate Emergency Call Pillars
safetyTips.summary: Physical blue light emergency pillars are situated near Tech Park, Library, and Thangel Promenade.

safetyTips.title: Keep Emergency Speed Dials
safetyTips.summary: Store SRM Main Gate Security (+91 98765 43210) and Hostel Warden numbers on your speed dial.

safetyTips.title: Personal Property Vigilance
safetyTips.summary: Never leave laptops, project kits, or personal bags unattended in Java canteen or library desks.
